title: Active Directory Attack Investigation
story: An attacker compromised Active Directory credentials. Students investigate privilege escalation and lateral movement.

tasks.title: Review Windows Logs
tasks.description: Inspect Windows security logs for suspicious authentication and privilege events.
tasks.hint: Review events for logon, ticket requests, and privilege use.

tasks.title: Detect Kerberos Abuse
tasks.description: Identify evidence of Kerberos abuse such as unusual ticket activity.
tasks.hint: Look for abnormal TGS requests or service ticket patterns.

tasks.title: Identify Compromised Accounts
tasks.description: Determine which account was abused by the attacker.
tasks.hint: Correlate failed logons, successful logons, and privilege changes.

tasks.title: Contain Attacker
tasks.description: Disable or reset compromised accounts and block active attacker access.
tasks.hint: Reset credentials, disable sessions, and review group memberships.
